sub6007: The story starts with the main character waking up to an alarm at 10 a.m.
She picks up her phone and notices it's been 30 days since the day she broke up with her boyfriend of 2 years Adam
she calls this day her monthiversary.
She chooses to snooze the alarm and go back to sleep.
She lays down and her face touches wet tissues that she used to dry her tears when she was crying due to her break up with Adam.
She notices a bear that Adam gave her
and that she moved to a corner of her bed.
She also sees the piano that she and Adam used to play together.
After the breakup she moved it as far away in the corner as possible.
She decides to go on Tinder and swipes right on a guy with a "butt chin" which reminds her of John Travolta.
It turns out that it's a match.
The guy's opening message to her is whether she's Team Captain America or Team Iron Man.
Team Captain America - she replies.
The guy tells her that he'll be at an arcade in 30 minutes
and asks her out.
The girl calls her best friend Lex
who starts the conversation by making a joke about the fact that it's been 30 days since she broke up with Adam.
This upsets the main character and Lex disconnects.
She calls right back
and voices her displeasure at the fact that the main character has been wallowing in her pity for the last 30 days.
The main character tells Lex of her Tinder date
and Lex replies that she'll be at the MC's place in 5 minutes.
After the 5 minutes the MC hears a thud in the distance.
Then she hears another.
She looks out of her window
and sees a yellow object being thrown at her window.
She goes down passing a mirror on her way out.
She notices that she's wearing her old My Little Pony t-shirt.
Overall she looks disheveled.
She goes out
and sees Lex resting against the hood of her car.
The MC notices that the yellow object that Lex was throwing at her window were Peanut M&M's.
Lex offers her a taste.
The MC recalls that Adam had a peanut allergy
and that she avoided anything with peanuts for the 2 years that she was dating him.
She wonders if she should eat some.
She decides to do so and lets one M&M to melt on her tongue.
Before eating them she looks at the characters on the packet.
The taste feels strange as she hasn't eaten anything with peanuts for the last 2 years.
She lets Lex into her apartment.
Lex helps her get ready for the date.
The MC decides between two dresses a white one and a red one.
The red one reminds her of Adam but she decides to wear it anyway.
Lex drives her to the arcade and they arrive on time.
Inside there's a blacklight and the MC feels like a glowstick in her dress.
She recognizes her date
but notices the fact that she forgot his name and doesn't want to look at her phone as he noticed her already and it's possible he might notice.
In her mind she simply calls him "The Tinder Guy".
She walks up to him
he has a wad of blue tickets.
He offers her a choice between skee ball and basketball hoops.
She decides to play basketball hoops.
Before they start playing he asks her to choose heads or tails.
She chooses heads.
He says that if it's heads she'll start and if it's tails he'll let her see his talent.
He flips a coin it's tails.
He throws the ball and misses.
He concentrates and throws again.
This time he scores.
He moves back and spills her drink on her dress.
When they first met he asked her whether she wanted a drink and had two choices water and red fruit punch.
She chose the punch.
After seeing his tickets she also looked over at the available gifts and noticed a teddy bear.
She decided that she wanted it as a replacement for the cuddle toy that Adam gave her last year.
After he spills the drink he says that she's gonna get the bear and give it to his mother.
This upsets the MC as she expected that since they're on a date that he would give it to her.
He says that there's a coffee place nearby that has a bathroom where she could clean up (the arcade doesn't have one).
They go to the cafe.
The MC reminisces about it as the Firefly cafe is close to her college campus and she went there often with Adam.
Since their breakup she hasn't visited it once.
The Tinder Guy mentions that he doesn't have money.
The MC is again upset as not only did he spill a drink on her dress but is now expecting her to pay for their coffee.
They enter the cafe.
A boy inside asks the MC to take a picture of him and his girlfriend.
The MC thinks that she's a bad photographer and doesn't like taking other peoples' pictures but nevertheless she agrees.
As the boy nears her he asks her quietly to take a video instead.
She obliges and starts the video.
The boy takes out a ukulele and starts serenading his girlfriend with a song by Train.
The MC notices a pug outside the window trying to get in.
She wants to turn to it but doesn't want to mess up the video.
Someone else enters the cafe and the pug gets inside.
He carries an engagement ring to the boy and he takes it and proposes to his girlfriend.
She says yes.
People in the cafe react enthusiastically and cheer.
The MC keeps the video rolling for a bit and then stops.
The boy comes up to her to thank her and takes the phone.
She proceeds going to the counter and notices a new handsome barista.
She thinks that he's hot.
He has tattoos and lots of muscles.
She looks at his nametag and sees that his name is Ryan.
She thinks to herself that so many Ryans are attractive - Ryan Gosling Ryan Reynolds Ryan Seacrest.
She doesn't immediately get his attention and after 60 seconds she clears her throat.
She asks for two coffees two specials of the day.
Ryan says that she doesn't strike him as a "special of the day" kind of girl.
She asks him what he means by that.
She also asks him how much she would have to pay him to spit in one of the coffees.
After noticing the guy that's she's on a date with he says that he would do it for free.
While she was taking the video of the couple she was thinking how her monthiversary of her breakup would be their anniversary.
As she's walking to her date she notices that he's on his phone and is using Tinder.
She's angry that after all this he's blowing her off completely.
She waits for the coffee.
Ryan brings them to the table.
She decides to grab one and throws it at her date.
The tinder guy is upset
and she reminds him of all the ways that he mistreated her during the date.
When they were waiting he said that he had to go as a girl was waiting for him.
He pointed at her standing outside and she acknowledged him.
After getting the coffee thrown at him he leaves angry.
The MC grabs the second coffee but Ryan tells her that he spit in it and that he would make her a new coffee for free.
The MC watches him work and while she doesn't know how to make good coffee she thinks that he's doing everything in an expert way.
Suddenly she sees him turn red
and he's replaced by a woman.
Ryan leaves the cafe.
The MC approaches the register and asks the woman about Ryan saying that she wanted to order something from him (scones I think).
The lady is the boss and she replies that Ryan was fired.
The MC leaves the cafe and tries to find him.
He's standing next to the car and asks him what happened.
He tells her that it was his first week and that he was being watched closely and he must have given one free coffee too much.
He drives off.
The MC feels bad and that she's responsible for him losing his job.
She decides to walk to her friend Lex who lives at a sorority house nearby.
She walked this route many times.
She arrives and Lex lets her in.
She vents to Lex
and Lex tells her that the best way to get over this day is to go to a party at the sorority house with her.
Lex skillfully applies many layers of make up to the MC's face.
She uses many products that the main character's not familiar with.
The MC looks at a mirror and makes a remark that the makeup makes it seem like she has cheekbones.
They go to the party where Lex immediately joins her sorority sisters.
One of the girls approaches the MC and recognizes her as Adam's girlfriend.
The MC replies that she's his ex girlfriend.
She's not familiar with the girl and only met her once or twice before.
The girl tells her a secret that Lex never approved of the MC's relationship with Adam.
The MC is upset and approaches Lex.
She admits but not immediately that she didn't approve of the relationship and always thought that the MC deserved better.
Better like Ryan who's also at the party and Lex makes the MC aware of that.
He's at the balcony.
The MC wants to go over to him but she also notices the Tinder Guy and she decides to hide.
She joins Lex's friends
but after the 50 selfies they took she grows tired and sits down.
The Tinder Guy approaches her upset at the fact that she threw the coffee at him.
Ryan sees the two of them and walks up forming a physical barrier between the two.
He tells the Tinder Guy that his team is losing in beer pong and tells him to go back playing.
Ryan sits down next to the MC.
The two begin a conversation that flows extremely well.
The MC notices that she got temporary abs from laughing so much.
They are interrupted by Lex who's drunk and lays down on the MC's lap.
She gags and the MC knows that she has to take her home.
Ryan helps her out.
The MC goes to Lex's car
and reflects on her conversation with Ryan.
She didn't get his contact information but his face has burned itself into her mind.
She drives Lex home.
Then she returns to her apartment.
She opens her closet and takes out a box.
Inside there's memorabilia that she saved from the two year relationship she had with Adam.
She reflects on the relationship noticing how every relationship changes a person.
She thinks how for every memory you make you have to give away a bit of yourself.
She comes to the conclusion that there are two choices for when a relationship ends.
You either cling to the past or accept that it ended and that you're a different person now.
She throws away the box.
It's 11:55 PM. She sits at the piano.
The keys are covered with dust.
She remembers how often she played it with Adam and how much joy it gave her.
Every time that they would play and Adam would touch her fingers she would feel incredible even two years into their relationship.
She plays the piano.
She notices it's 11:59.
Once a new day starts she comes to peace with their relationship ending and that she's starting a new chapter in her life.
sub6021: I am Emily
the story starts with me waking up feeling bad after a breakup with my ex Adam
I am really sad about that and can't move on
I reminisce about playing piano with him.
I look into the mirror and take a good look at myself.
After that I return to the bed and open Tinder
and swipe right on a guy with a buttchin or whatever
Then I get a message from him like 20 seconds later asking if I am "team captain america or team iron man"
I answer captain america and he says to meet him at the arcade in 30 minutes.
After that I call my best friend Lex
and she at first jokes that it is my monthiversary or something of my breakup and I hang up angry.
She calls back after a second and I explain the situation.
She gets to my house in her car in 5 minutes
and starts throwing m&m's at my window.
I go outside
and meet her leaning against her car's hood.
She has blonde hair and a pierced nose.
After talking and tasting peanuts for the first time after two years because of Adam's allergy.
She helps me dress up for the date and I chose a red dress that reminds me of my ex.
After another 20mins Lex drops me off at the arcade and head inside.
There I find Tinder guy waiting for me.
I don't remember his name so he's Tinder guy for the rest of the story.
He offers to order me a drink and I take him up on that.
I order a soda and we go play some games.
We play basketball hoops because there's a penguin plushie I want.
We toss a coin for who will play first and he loses.
He misses the first throw and hits the next
but spills a drink on my red dress in the process.
It really upsets me and after that he asks if he can take the penguin for his mom.
I say sure.
He then offers to take me to a local cafe and buy me some coffee in return.
That's the least he can do but when we get there he suddenly says he doesn't have any spare money so I have to pay for him.
But before I do that some dude asks me to take a picture of him and his girlfriend and then tells me to actually record.
He proceeds to propose to his girlfriend while I record.
He proposes by playing marry me on an ukulele.
After his new fiancé agrees a pug comes into the cafe and he retrieves a ring from its collar.
I end the recording hand him the phone and congratulate him.
After that I finally order the coffee and notice the cute barista named Ryan.
I try to bribe him to spit into the drink of Tinder guy
while he tries to hook up with another chick on his phone.
Ryan takes me up on the offer for free.
I return to the table and Tinder guy tries to leave with some excuse because another girl is waiting for him outside.
Before he can do that though I spill coffee on his shirt as Ryan just came to serve it.
Tinder guy leaves pissed.
Ryan then offers me a free coffee.
I take him up on it and observe him prepare it but before he can finish he's called back to the back
and argues with his supervisor.
He leaves soon after and leaves his apron on the counter.
I ask the supervisor who's now serving me what happened.
She says that Ryan's fired and asks me what I wanted to drink.
I decided that I am not hungry anymore and leave to find Ryan.
I find him getting into his car in the parking lot.
I ask him why he got fired and after he tells me that its because he served too much free coffee in the first week of his work there.
I apologize.
I feel guilty but he tells me its okay and drives off.
I then go to Lex's place.
She lives in a sorority house.
I get to her room and tell her how my date went but she already knows from the look on my face.
We then decide to go to a frat party.
Before we do that Lex gives me a huge makeover involving five layers of makeup.
I also get one of her dresses.
We head to another sorority house.
There is a massive party at the house.
People playing beer pong and dancing.
I greet Lex's sorority sisters and one of them tells me a secret.
Lex didn't approve of my relationship with Adam.
I confront her about that and she confirms it.
After it she makes it up to me by pointing out that Ryan is also there.
He's hanging out on the balcony.
I try to approach him but notice Tinder guy in reflection and quickly retreat.
I start to dance and after a while get a headache and decide to chill for a bit on a couch.
Also before that I play charades with Lex as I got called out by some random guy to do that.
After chilling on the sofa for a bit Tinder guy approaches me out of nowhere and recognizes me as the girl who spilled coffee on him.
I bite back but Ryan intervenes and tells Tinder guy to go finish his beer pong game while he watches from the couch.
I think up of an opener which happens to be recognizing his tattoo from one of my classes.
He seems impressed and we start to chat. We continue to chat for hours. Around 3 hours or so.
I learn about his kid sister.
His dream home in Arizona how he believes that weathermen are TV's illuminati and some other things.
At some point Lex comes to sleep on lap after drinking too much.
She at one point sounds like she's about to puke but stops and returns to sleep.
After some more talking I decide to finally take Lex home.
To my surprise Ryan offers to drive me to Lex's place.

I agree and we start to head out but before we can pass the main door Tinder guy shows up and start to talk something about "how can I leave his house after spilling coffee on him and not making it up"
thankfully Ryan handles him and signals me to leave.
I wait for him for sometime outside but decide to leave after some time.
I get Lex home and then return to mine.
I start to think about today and the events that transpired.
It is eleven fifty-five I open my close and retrieve a box full of souvenirs and other memorabilia.
I decide to move on as clock passes twelve.
I finally start my life anew.
